title: Plugin and SDK mismatch
content:
I am trying to build the api SDK; I loaded the newest version. However, there is a mismatch between the plugin and the SDK file, as AutoHang si expecting 4 arguments, but is getting only 3, LoadLibraryColorSwatch is expecting 2 arguments, but is getting only 1. I wonder how I can get the newest plugin that can get all the necessary arguments for the above mentioned functions. 


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi, if your question is not answered in the CLO API documentation here https://developer.clo3d.com/, you will have to open a ticket to tech support as CLO and MD designers cannot assist with the topic: https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus/technical
content_description: This web page aims to provide guidance on resolving API SDK compatibility issues by obtaining the latest plugin versions that meet the required argument specifications for the functions AutoHang and LoadLibraryColorSwatch.

title: ✨ Excited to share my 2024 3D clothing design collection! 🌟
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/4afc5ea240ba42a4ba1e9ae515d62006Slide%2016_9%20-%20167.jpg)

Hello everyone, I am a 3D fashion designer and 3D artist from China.​​​​​​​

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/9996a7f67da641009077851b39e08dbf11111248.png)

I would like to share a series of 3D fashion works I completed in 2024, which were mainly designed for non-realistic characters. These pieces come from different projects, which I have re-rendered and compiled into this collection to review my learning journey and project practice in 2024. All of them were created using CLO3D and Marvelous Designer for 3D clothing design and rendered in C4D. I also use Blender for creating and modifying some basic models.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/25fe6c53a74142b8b783386e95b6c1d511111252.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/72c84c3dabfd4cc98216bfbfd025ef5311111251.png)

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/5da3fde3a8454da29e18681a91f265fc11111250.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/5914b4d7673f42b4af2a70b330bfa8e611111253.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/0b796677874a4748afa4afa87b6a92ef11111258.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/4884efe82a6347fbb8405b380139f77411111254.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/5b796c6c2b9245c09172d1eb7beb2dae11111255.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/1a5626e0ccaa40879b32763840efb33011111256.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/15d89c5528e0445896e0eace103f12e511111257.png)

In my continuous learning process, I have deeply experienced the infinite possibilities of CLO3D and Marvelous Designer. These software connect multiple industries, integrate virtual reality, and link various styles. Throughout 2024, I not only created many realistic-style garments but also explored various styles including non-realistic IP characters and realistic fashion short films. In the future, I will continue to learn other 3D software to expand the boundaries of my creative work.✨

title: Fabric preset settings
content:
Can anyone share more detailed info about the fabric preset settings in marvelous designer.


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Sure! You have different options distributed by types of real-life fabrics. If you are looking for more specific behavior, you can always use a default fabric and adjust the parameters.If you are new to Marvelous Designer, I would recommend using the Default_For_Simulation and getting used to the different tools in the software.Once you want to achieve a desired garment, you should research the fabric used in real life for its production and use one of the options from our default set.If you are looking for a fabric with more solid behavior, you can try Trim_Fusible_Rigid, Trim_Hardware, or Trim_Full_Grain_Leather. It will obviously depend on the objective, but they surely have base parameters that can serve as a good starting point.If you need more info, let me know!
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to gather and share detailed information about fabric preset settings in Marvelous Designer to enhance users' understanding and usage of the software.

title: How to make drawstrings pass over the waistband ?
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/10408eead82846569912ed3af53b9ed9/images/87f53d14feda496ab201e2099e156324737350602_0340_0340.jpg)

Hello,

I am currently working on a pair of shorts with drawstrings. Using the **Layer** function, I successfully attached the drawstrings to the inside of the waistband. However, I want the drawstrings to pass over the top edge of the waistband (visible on the outside) instead of being hidden inside.

The process to achieve this seems very laborious. Is there a more efficient way to make the drawstrings appear sewn or attached at the back but exit and drape naturally over the waistband?

Thank you for your advice!


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: You can try using the sewing tool to direct the drawstrings and apply a specific angle to force them down once they are over the waistband. You can find this option in the seam properties.
content_description: This webpage serves as a resource for sewing enthusiasts seeking efficient methods to creatively attach and display drawstrings on garments.
